links.outcome: Expert Likert ratings of diagnosis identification versus diagnostic-workup and surgical recommendations
links.effect: Most likely diagnosis scored 4.53 ± 0.51, but recommendations for further diagnostic evaluation scored 2.17 ± 0.83 and surgical necessity assessment 1.93 ± 0.64.
links.quote: Lower scores were recorded for recommendations regarding further diagnostic evaluation (2.17 ± 0.83) and assessment of surgical necessity (1.93 ± 0.64).

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and accuracy of a structured GPT-4-based workflow (LipoAssist) on simulated lipedema clinical scenarios with physician ratings, without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
